Question: The straight line \(AB\) is divided at \(C\) so that \(\overline{AC}=3\overline{CB}.\) Circles are described on \(\overline{AC}\) and \(\overline{CB}\) as diameters and a common tangent meets \(\overline{AB}\) produced at \(D.\) Then \(\overline{BD}\) equals:

Choices.A: the diameter of the smaller circle
Choices.B: the radius of the smaller circle
Choices.C: the radius of the larger circle
Choices.E: the difference of the two radii
